question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
WITH constructor_points AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        cs.constructor_id,
        SUM(cs.points) as total_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
    HAVING SUM(cs.points) > 0
),
min_per_year AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(total_points) as min_points
    FROM constructor_points
    GROUP BY year
),
worst_constructors AS (
    SELECT 
        cp.constructor_id,
        c.name,
        COUNT(*) as seasons_with_fewest_points
    FROM constructor_points cp
    JOIN min_per_year mp ON cp.year = mp.year AND cp.total_points = mp.min_points
    JOIN constructors c ON cp.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    GROUP BY cp.constructor_id, c.name
)
SELECT * FROM worst_constructors
ORDER BY seasons_with_fewest_points DESC, constructor_id
LIMIT 5
